title: fix: reject unknown transparent and audio values on image and video
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: The `/image/{prompt}` and `/video/{prompt}` routes now return HTTP 400 for unknown `transparent` or `audio` query values instead of silently treating them as `false`. Both parameters reuse the text route’s BooleanQueryParamSchema: `true/1/yes/on` and `false/0/no/off` remain accepted. `safe` is unchanged because it already rejects unknown values. Two regression tests cover the new behavior.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli sorts tiny `yes`, `no`, and `?` query-value tiles beside an image-and-video terminal, placing the unknown tile next to a small pixel-font `400`; lime green (#ecf874) code-plants glow against warm cream and pastel gradients. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny debugging glasses, stays small-to-medium in the scene, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic — cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
